title: A missing bounds check
note: The patch inserts an unsigned bounds check before the indexed load. The vulnerable build reads a[i] for any i, including out-of-range and negative values; the fix rejects i >= 4 first. This added compare-and-branch is the entire security fix.

title: A signed check made unsigned
note: The only change is the comparison: the vulnerable build uses a signed test (so a negative index passes), the patch uses an unsigned one. A single changed branch instruction is the fix — the kind of one-instruction delta patch-diffing exists to find.

title: A size multiply with no overflow check
note: The patch adds the overflow guard before the multiply: if count exceeds INT64_MAX/width the product would wrap, so the fix rejects it. Without it, count*width overflows to a small size the caller then trusts for an allocation.

title: An off-by-one in the bound
note: The array holds four elements, so the valid indices are 0..3. The vulnerable build rejects only i > 4, admitting index 4 — one past the end. The patch changes the comparison to i >= 4. A single changed branch is the whole fix.
